segments.narration: Compare the counted goods with the delivery note before signing. A difference needs supervisor review.

activities.instructions: Compare twelve listed cartons with ten counted. Enter the difference.
activities.scoring: One puzzle worth ten points; no extra points for replay.
activities.failure_retry: Three lives; show hint after a wrong answer, allow a fresh practice restart.
activities.feedback: Two cartons are missing; document and escalate before signoff.
activities.accessible_alternative: Read text versions of the note and count; enter answer by keyboard.
